title: CIA Symbolic Proxy Image Pool
purpose: Small remote image registry for humorous symbolic dossier imagery without storing large binaries in the repository.
boundary: Every image is a symbolic proxy for a project role/object. It is not a portrait, likeness, identity claim or evidence that the pictured object/person is the dossier subject.
selection_rule: Dossiers may deterministically borrow up to three images whose role_terms match source-bounded role labels or symbolic-role text. The same dossier should resolve to the same primary proxy until its role set changes.
